description: This file defines container classes for neural network modules in PyTorch, including Sequential, ModuleList, ModuleDict, ParameterList, and ParameterDict, along with a deprecated Container class. It manages registration, iteration, and manipulation of submodules and parameters within neural network models.

classes.name: Container
classes.description: A deprecated container class for modules, replaced by nn.Module.

classes.name: Sequential
classes.description: A container that chains modules sequentially, forwarding input through each module.

classes.name: ModuleList
classes.description: A list-like container for modules, allowing indexed access and manipulation.

classes.name: ModuleDict
classes.description: A dictionary-like container for modules, maintaining insertion order.

classes.name: ParameterList
classes.description: A list-like container for parameters, converting tensors to Parameters on addition.

classes.name: ParameterDict
classes.description: A dictionary-like container for parameters, converting tensors to Parameters on addition.

methods.name: _addindent
methods.description: Helper function to indent multi-line strings for representation.

methods.name: forward
methods.description: Runs input through the chain of modules in Sequential.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Appends a module or parameter to the container.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a module at a specified index in Sequential or ModuleList.

methods.name: extend
methods.description: Extends Sequential or ModuleList with multiple modules.

methods.name: pop
methods.description: Removes and returns a module or parameter by index or key.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates ModuleDict or ParameterDict with new key-value pairs.

methods.name: keys
methods.description: Returns an iterable of keys in ModuleDict or ParameterDict.

methods.name: items
methods.description: Returns an iterable of key-value pairs in ModuleDict or ParameterDict.

methods.name: values
methods.description: Returns an iterable of values in ModuleDict or ParameterDict.

methods.name: extra_repr
methods.description: Provides extra string representation of ParameterList or ParameterDict.
